description: Cross-language test vectors for minimal L1 (taxicab) voice leading between pitch-class sets. Every implementation (TS reference, Lua/PdLua, C++) must reproduce these sizes exactly. Sizes are symmetric: size(from,to) === size(to,from).
algorithm: Tymoczko 2006 supplement, dynamic-programming matrix with cyclic extension, doublings allowed

cases.name: I to IV (C to F major)
I to V (C to G major)
triad to seventh (C to C7, doubling)
C major triad to full chromatic neighbor (B major)
V-I resolution (G7 to C major, doubling)
